messages:
Maria Chen: heads up — deploybot flagged a canary latency regression on release v2.6.0 at 11:03 UTC. p95 jumped ~220ms over baseline. @DeployBot what's the auto-rollback threshold?
DeployBot: auto-rollback threshold: p95 > 150ms sustained for 5m OR error-rate > 2% for 3m. Current signal: p95=220ms sustained 4m, error-rate 0.9%. recommendation: hold and escalate (no auto-rollback yet). :eyes:
Ajay Patel: we have two dedicated customers on this pool. prefer to avoid full auto-revert without ops signoff. can we do a targeted traffic split back to previous model for 10% to reduce impact?
Liz Ortega: agreed with Ajay. manual fallback plan: pin traffic -> 90% back to v2.5.1, keep 10% on v2.6 to gather traces. i'll lead the rollback exec if we decide.
Sam Roberts: also add to release notes and notify CS + account managers for the two dedicated customers. draft message ready, will post once rollback decision is final.
Maria Chen: what's the exact pin command? will need runbook and ticket.
Nikhil Rao: creating INCIDENT-5478 rollback ticket and runbook link: https://tickets.internal/INCIDENT-5478 — assigning to @Liz Ortega for exec.
Nikhil Rao: runbook snippet: ```
# traffic pin to previous model
redwoodctl rollout set --model v2.5.1 --percent 90 --target pool:canary-gpu
redwoodctl rollout monitor --until p95<=150ms OR 15m
```
DeployBot: note — if p95 crosses 300ms or error-rate > 3% for 2m, auto-escalation will trigger a full revert.
Liz Ortega: executing pin in 2m. ops will watch metrics and traces. Sam please send the customer heads-up after i confirm traffic shift.
Sam Roberts: +1. here's the customer note draft: "We're observing higher latency on today's rollout (v2.6.0). We're shifting most traffic back to the prior stable variant while we investigate. No data loss. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." will tag account owners.
Ajay Patel: thumbs up. once pin completes, let's capture a small sampling of failing requests and correlation IDs to link to evals. avoid broad rollbacks unless signal worsens.
Maria Chen: thanks — ping when done. also flag any regression in the release notes so we can mark the CI gate for next patch.
Liz Ortega: pin applied at 11:08 UTC. monitoring. so far p95 -> 140ms after 3m. continuing watch. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: great, closing the loop: manual rollback executed, customers notified, ticket INCIDENT-5478 created. we will update postmortem if root cause identified.
Sam Roberts: posting customer note now. will follow-up with internal release-note entry and link to the ticket.
Nikhil Rao: adding owners for full postmortem: Maria, Liz, Nikhil, Sam. leaving ticket open.
DeployBot: automated guardrails still active. will alert if any of thresholds hit.
Ajay Patel: thanks team — nice quick handoff.
Maria Chen: :heart:
